invariants.rationale: The method can only safely access tooltip fields and methods if tooltip is non-null.
A valid Tooltip typically has a non-null container for UI actions.
Invocations on getColor() are performed; implies getColor() should not return null.
getActions() is permissible to call, implying it is either non-null or, if empty, that is a valid state.
Setting positive scale values for a UI component is typical prior to animation.
